threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Overground' instead of knowing it's just the East London Line to most locals.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken from a late-night stall while waiting for the 35; always surprising how much life is still buzzing around at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh shawarma wafting through the streets at 2 AM after a long night, and suddenly you realize it’s home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice that the U-Bahn stations here have some of the weirdest art installations? Like, a giant rubber duck at Warschauer Straße. Totally Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by their ability to navigate the ever-changing bus routes while still rolling their eyes at BART delays. We’ve seen it all.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a Muni bus stop for a pigeon crossing the street like it was a VIP. Only in the TL do we respect the hustle of all city residents.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, missing the real gem: the small, tucked-away square where locals gather for the best vermut.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still think wearing sandals with socks is a quirky fashion statement, not a tourist flag.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Dalston Junction' instead of just 'Junction.' Locals know to drop that fancy title once you're here a while.
Caught a night bus from Brixton, and a bloke started singing ‘Wonderwall’ like it was a karaoke bar. Best impromptu gig I’ve seen in ages.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw someone walking their pet ferret on a leash near the canal – felt like a scene from a local movie.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab shop that serves late-night currywurst, both wrapped in a pita. Pair it with a berliner Weisse and you’ve hit the jackpot.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from the Mission if they carry a permanent stash of hot sauce in their bag—gotta be ready for any burrito emergency.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy doing yoga in the back of a packed 38 Geary. Only in SF would that feel totally normal, even after the usual delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all live off tapas and sangria. Meanwhile, we're just trying to get our café amb llet fix in peace before work.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones staring wide-eyed at the menu, fumbling with their phones while trying to translate every word, oblivious to the waiters’ amused glances.
